review: FangHunt Hong Lu is a Rupture ID that becomes stronger when facing a Bloodfiend or a Bloodbag enemy. This makes him excellent in Canto 7 and Murder on the Warp Express event as most enemies there are Bloodfiends and Bloodbags. First, let’s talk about his Passive which when active gives him a 10% damage boost. The second part of the Passive allows him to inflict 3 Rupture Potency on hit if he has self Bleed. While this can act as a mini Talisman like Red Sheet Sinclair, do note that it requires self Bleed which means taking a hit from a Skill with Bleed Count or against enemies that inflict Bleed Passively. Furthermore, this is capped at 2 times per turn meaning a second Slot and Skill 3 won’t benefit at all from the Passive.
